verses.text: Tato yel tze k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal swalkan tik t'ayex, te niwan ol aj heyelk'och yuj Jehová chi' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Hanhejtona' tato tze k'anab'ajej Jehová ko Diosal, ol he chapax masanil juntzanh yaxilal ol wal tik:
Ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a heyib'anh t'a yol he chonhab' yet' t'a he munlajel.
Ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb' heyuninal, t'a yib'anh tas tzeyawej, t'a yib'anh yune' nok' he wakax, yune' nok' he kalnel yet' t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok'.
Ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh tas ol heyak'em t'a yol he mo'och yet' t'a yib'anh tas tze wa'a.
Ol yak'an swach'k'olal t'a heyib'anh b'ajtak tzex ek'i yet' yik tzex meltzajxi t'a he pat.
Ha Jehová ol ak'anoch heb' heyajk'o'ol t'a yol he k'ab' ayik ol yak'an owal heb' heyet'ok. T'a stzolal ol aj skot heb' t'ayex, palta sakleminak ol aj yel heb' elelal t'ayex.

Ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a yib'anh tastak tzeyik' t'a he munlajel yet' t'a yib'anh masanil tas tze k'ulej. Icha wal chi' te tzalajk'olal ol hex ajek' t'a sat lum lum ol yak' Jehová chi' t'ayex.
Tato tze k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il Jehová chi', tze b'eyb'alani, ol hex yalnhejoch schonhab'ok to sik'b'ilex el yuj, icha ajnak yalani.
Haxo heb' anima t'a masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol yojtakejel heb' to sik'b'il hex el yuj Jehová, ol xiw heb' t'ayex.
Ha Jehová chi' ol hex xajananok: Tzijtum ol aj heyuninal yet' yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok', jantak ol aj sat heyawb'en t'a lum lum yak'nak sti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham to ol yak' t'ayex.

Ol yak'ankot nhab' t'a yib'anh lum lum tik t'a stiempo'al, icha jantak tz'och yopisio. Te wach'xonhej ol aj he munlajel. Masanil tastak ay t'ayex, ol te k'ib'cha'anh, masanto ol yal heyak'an majanil t'a tzijtumok nación. Ha hexxo pax tik, malaj tas ol he k'an he majnej t'a junokxo mach.

Tato ol he k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal, haton masanil juntzanh swalkan t'ayex tikne'ik, sat ol hex aj t'a heb' ch'ok nacional chi', haxo heb' spatiktak ol ajkan heb'. Niwan ol aj heyelk'och t'a yib'anh heb'. Malaj b'aj ol hex ak'jok ganar yuj heb'.
Icha chi' ol hex ajok, tato max heyik'el he b'a t'a spatik scheknab'il Jehová, tato max hex och tzak'an t'a spatik komon Dios, yik tzeyak'anem he b'a t'ay.
Palta tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová ko Diosal, haton juntzanh wan walan tik t'ayex, ol ja wal juntzanh katab' tik t'a heyib'anh:
Te chuk heyik t'a yol he chonhab' yet' t'a he munlajel.
Syalelk'ochi to malaj tas ol heyik' t'a he munlajel chi', malaj pax tas ol he wa'a.
Ol jawok yahelal t'a yib'anh heb' heyuninal, malaj swach'il ol aj sat heyawb'en. Manh ol k'ib' yune' nok' he wakax, yune' nok' he kalnel, yune' nok' he chiwa yet' masanil nok' he molb'etzal nok'.
Chuk heyik b'ajtaknhej tzex ek'i yet' yik tzex meltzajxi t'a he pat.
Ol yak'kot yahelal Jehová yet' ilk'olal t'a heyib'anh. Toxonhej ol hex somchajel t'a masanil tastak ol he k'ulej. Elanhchamel ol hex satel yuj chukal tze k'ulej yuj heyaktankan Jehová chi'.
Ha Jehová ol ak'ankot juntzanh ilya te ow t'a heyib'anh, masanto ol hex satel t'a sat lum lum b'aj ol hex kajnaj chi'.

Ol yak'paxkot yab'il yab'il Jehová chi' to ol hex cham yuj, k'ak'al ilya te chuk yet' he malk'e'i. Haxo heyawb'en ol takjokelok. Manhxo ol yak'laj nhab', takinh ol aj smasanil. Ol och tz'a'ub' t'a he munlajel masanto ol yal he sateli.
Manhxalaj nhab' ol kot t'a satcha'anh. Manhxo ol yak'laj sat heyawb'en t'a lum lum chi'.
Manhxalaj nhab' ol yak'a'. Haxonhej lum pokok yet' k'e'en arena ol em yuj Jehová ko Diosal, masanto ol hex satelok.

Ha Jehová chi' ol hex ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' heyajk'o'ol. T'a stzolal ol aj he b'at t'a owal, haxo ol ajok, sakleminak ol aj heyel t'a heb'. Ol sat sk'o'ol masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik ayik ol yab'an heb' tas ol hex ik'anok.
Ha nok' ostok yet' nok' kaltakte'al nok' ol chi'anb'at he niwanil. Manhxalaj mach ol xib'tan nok' t'ayex.
Ha Jehová ol ak'an k'ab'at he niwanil yuj mal yab'il, icha wal ajnak heb' aj Egipto. Ol k'epax kisk'oy t'ayex yet' yaxk'a yet' k'ilaj yab'il, manhxalaj yanhal juntzanh ilya chi'.
Ol hex kistalaxok, ol somchajel he k'o'ol, manhxo ol yal-laj heyilani.

Toxonhej ol hex ek' machmon t'a chimk'uhalil, icha tz'aj yek' machmon heb' max ujitaxon yilani. Haxo t'a masanil tas ol he k'ulej, manhxalaj tas ol elk'och t'a wach'il. Ol hex te ixtaxelok. Ilb'ajk'olxonhej ol hex ajok. Manhxalaj mach ol hex kolanok.
Ha mach ol sb'o strato snupnaj yet' junok ix ix, ch'okxo mach ol way yet' ix. Ol he b'ok'e junok he pat, palta manhxo ol hex kajnaj t'a yo'ol. Ol heyawej junok heyuwa, palta manhxo ol he lo sat.

T'a wal heyichanh ol smilcham nok' he wakax heb' ajk'o'ol, palta manh ol he chi' jab'ok schib'ejal nok'. T'a heyichanh ol yik'b'at nok' he b'uru heb', manhxo ol yak' meltzaj nok' heb' t'ayex. Ol yik'b'at nok' he kalnel heb', manhxalaj mach ol yal skolankan nok' t'a heb'.
Heyichanh wal ol b'atkan heb' heyuninal yet' heb' ix heyisil t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il. Toxonhej ol hex k'unb'ok he maklan sjax heb', palta manhxa jab'ok tas syal heyu'uj.
Ha heb' anima manh heyojtakok, ha heb' ol satanel masanil sat heyawb'en yet' jantak he munlajel. Ol hex ixtaj wal, ob'iltakxonhej ol hex ajok.
Ayik ol heyilan masanil juntzanh chi', toxonhej ol hex kistalaxkanok.
Ol yak' wal kot yahelal Jehová t'a heyib'anh, ol k'e yab'il yaxk'a t'a sjolom he penek, t'a he xub' yet' t'a masanil he niwanil. Manhxo ol anhtaj jun ilya chi' heyu'uj.

Ol hex ik'jokb'at yuj Jehová chi' yet' he reyal sik'b'iloch heyu'uj t'a junok nación to manh heyojtakok, manh yojtakokpax heb' he mam heyicham. Hata' ol heyak'em he b'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios b'ob'il t'a te te', ma t'a k'e'en k'e'en.
Ol sat sk'o'ol juntzanhxo nación yab'an tas ol hex utajok. Ol aljok he pekal, ol hex b'uchjok yuj juntzanh chonhab' b'aj ol hex yik'b'at Jehová chi'.
Te niwan inhat ol heyawej, palta jab'nhej sat ol he molo', anhej nok' k'ulub' ol k'uxanb'atok.
Ol heyawej heyuwa, ol he mesani, palta manh ol he b'ixlaj sat, malaj wino ol heyuk'ej, anhej nok' yaxtaj ol lajanelok.
Ay te' olivo t'a sat he lu'um, palta malaj yaceite'al te' ol he k'ana' yujto tonhej ol k'ajb'anel sat te'.
Ay heyuninal, ay heyisil, palta manh ol ajlaj heb' heyet'ok, yujto ol ik'jokb'at heb' t'a juntzanhxo nación.
Masanil te te' syak' sat t'a he chonhab', pilan ol lajwokel te' yuj nok' k'ulub'.
Ha heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal, niwanxo ol aj yelk'och heb' t'a heyichanh, ha hexxo tik, manhxalaj ol aj heyelk'ochi yujto ol hex lajwokemok.
Ha heb' chi', ay tas ol yal yak'an heb' majanil, palta ha hexxo tik, manhxalaj tas t'ayex. Ha heb' sat ol aj t'ayex, ha hexxo tik spatiktakil ol hex ajkanok.
Masanil juntzanh yahelal tik ol ja t'a heyib'anh. Ol heyab'xonhej sya'il masanto ol yal he sateli, yujto maj he k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová ko Diosal ix yak' t'ayex.
Ha juntzanh yahelal tik sch'oxkot yowal sk'o'ol Dios t'ayex yet' t'a heb' heyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo.
Yujto maj heyak'em he b'a t'a Jehová ko Diosal t'a tzalajk'olal yet' t'a smasanil he k'o'ol ayik ix yak'an swach'k'olal t'a heyib'anh,

yuj chi' yowalil ol heyak' serwil heb' ajk'o'ol ol yak'kot t'ayex, ol heyab' sya'il wejel, takinhti'al, manh pichulal yet' masanil yahelal. Ol heyab' wal sya'il yuj heb' heyajk'o'ol chi' masanto ol yal he sateli.

Ha heb' anima t'a junok nación te najat b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ha heb' ol yik'kot Jehová t'ayex, yelk'olal ol aj skot heb' icha sjenhwi nok' ch'akb'a. Ch'ok ti'al syal heb', manh ol heyab'laj tas ol yal heb'.
Te owal anima heb'. Malaj yelk'och heb' icham anima yet' heb' unin t'a heb'.

Ol schib'at yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok' heb', ol slo'anb'at sat heyawb'en te' heb', masanto ol hex ixtajwal. Manhxalaj he trigo, he wino, heyaceite, ma yune' nok' he wakax yet' yune' nok' he kalnel ol to kan yuj heb', anhej to ol hex cham yuj wejel.

Ol och hoyan heb' ajk'o'ol chi' t'a spatiktak he chonhab'. Ol jawok heb' t'ayex masanto ol yal yem lanhnaj smuro'al he chonhab' cha'anh yajk'e'i yet' b'aj skol sb'a heb' soldado ayoch yipok he k'o'ol. Masanil juntzanh chonhab' ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, ol laj yoymitej heb'.

Ayik ol laj oymaj heb' ajk'o'ol chi' t'a he chonhab' chi', haxo yuj wejel ol he chi'anb'at heyuninal yet' heyisil ix yak' Jehová ko Diosal. Wach'chom ay junok winak t'a he kal te wach' syutej sb'a, palta yuj wejel chi' ol schib'at yuninal. Manh ol yak' jab'ok t'a yuk'tak, t'a ix yetb'eyum to xajan yuj yet' t'a juntzanhxo yuninal olto kanok.

Wach'chom ay junok ix ix manh komonok syutej sb'a t'a he kal, te b'eyum ix, malaj b'aj tz'em yok ix t'a sat lu'um, aynhejoch xanhab' ix, palta yujto manhxa tas swa ix yuj b'aj oyanoch heb' ajk'o'ol t'a spatiktak he chonhab' chi', ol schib'at yune' ix toto tz'alji yet' smoj yune' chi'. Manh ol yak' jab'ok ix t'a winh yetb'eyum, ma t'a juntzanhxo yune'.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal te wach', te ay smay, palta tato malaj yelk'och t'ayex, manh ol he b'eyb'alejpax masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tz'ib'ab'ilkan tik,
ol yak' wal kot niwak yahelal ko Diosal chi' t'a heyib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh heyinhtilal. Ha wal ilya te chuk ol yak' t'a heyib'anh to manhxalaj yanhal.
Ol kot wal juntzanh ilya t'a heyib'anh, icha wal juntzanh ilya ik'annak heb' aj Egipto, haton juntzanh b'aj te xiwnak hex. Manhxo ol el-laj juntzanh yahelal chi' t'a heyib'anh.
Ayto juntzanhxo yahelal max b'inajlaj t'a juntzanh slolonel Dios tik ol jawok t'a heyib'anh yik tzex sateli.

Ha hex wal tik hex wetisraelal, te niwanxo he b'isul, lajan hexxo icha k'e'en k'anal t'a satcha'anh, palta ol hex satelok. Manhxo niwanok ol ajkan he b'isul, tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej Jehová ko Diosal.

Icha ix aj stzalaj sk'o'ol sch'oxan swach'k'olal t'ayonh, ix yak'an k'ib' ko b'isul, icha pax chi' ol aj stzalaj sk'o'ol yuj he sateli. Elanhchamel ol aj hex yik'anxi'el t'a lum lum b'aj toxo ol hex kajnaj tik.

Ha hex olto hex kanok, ha Jehová ol hex saklemankanb'at b'ajtak slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Hata' ol hex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios b'ob'il t'a te te', ma t'a k'e'en k'e'en, haton komon Dios b'aj max heyak'em he b'a, manh yak'nakokpaxem sb'a heb' ko mam kicham t'ay.

Ayik ayex ek' t'a juntzanh nación chi', manh ol heyik' jab'ok heyip, malaj jab'ok tas b'aj ay heyalan heyiko'. Yujto t'a xiwk'olal ol hex ajek' yuj Jehová ta', kuseltakxonhej ol aj yilji he sat yuj ilk'olal.
Xiwk'olal ol hex ajek' t'a masanil tiempo yuj he chamel. Ol hex te xiw t'a k'uhalil yet' t'ak'walil.
Ol hex te xiw wal sik'lab'il yuj juntzanh te ay smay ol heyila'. Ha t'a k'inhib'alil ol heyala': Tzok wal k'ik'b'i, xe chama. Haxo t'ak'walil ol heyalanxi: Tzok sakb'i, xe chama.

Wach'chom ix yal Jehová to manhxa b'ak'inh tzex meltzaj t'a Egipto, palta ha ol hex ak'anxib'at ta' t'a yol barco. Hata' ol he chonhoch he b'a schekab'ok heb' heyajk'o'ol chi', palta manhxalaj mach ol hex mananok, xchi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb'.
